name: Rocktusk Farm
summary: Swine feed Orgrimmar from Rocktusk Farm, just beyond the city gates in northern Durotar. The farm supplies meat and provisions to the capital, where dry, stony ground makes crops hard to grow.

sections.title: Provisions for the Capital
sections.body: Rocktusk Farm raises hardy swine on Durotar’s dry, stony ground. Crops are difficult to grow here, so the farm helps feed Orgrimmar’s growing population. Close to the capital’s fortified perimeter, it is safer than homesteads in the wild red canyonlands.

faq.q: What is Rocktusk Farm used for?
faq.answer: Rocktusk Farm raises swine for meat and provisions for Orgrimmar, where arable land is scarce.
Rocktusk Farm sits in northern Durotar, just southwest of Orgrimmar’s main gates along the road, beside rocky bluffs.

faq.q: Is the farm safe from wild beasts?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar’s closeness and nearby Horde patrols make the farm safer than most outlying homesteads, though wild beasts and roaming pests still prowl its outskirts.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see how the swine from this farm help feed the warriors and laborers stationed in Orgrimmar.
As a cook, you can use the farm’s pigs for fresh pork, ribs, and savory cuts to roast.
